cause: Explicit search requests expired observed advertising-entry authority, but a product GET whose actual redirect chain entered another search retained earlier authority.

controlled_red.failure: Expected permission denial did not occur.

correction: Expire earlier source links when an explicit non-search navigation actually enters any allowed search route, whether the final document is a search or a product. Cursor-only reads introduce no new navigation.
limitations: Controlled permission tests only; no outbound navigation to the new host.
Full final-source validation must be restarted after the correction.
The new sponsored-host scope and Code provider amendment still require the pending external authorization/input.
